subject: soc-rt-fy
title: SOC.RT.DY.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 141 (ALT(FT)II-35). SOC-RT-FY (the title writes SOC-RT-DY) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: POL-CON (political consciousness), EXPM (expansionism) and INFO-DY. From POL-CON: ACT (activism). From ACT: RT-DT. From EXPM: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From INFO-DY: INFO-FM (information forum) and DOC (documentation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-FM: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
